title: Pushforward along a closed immersion of the products with the powers of an extended ideal
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion] with ideal sheaf $\mathcal J$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals, and let $\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z\subseteq\mathcal O_Z$ be the image of $i^*\mathcal I\to i^*\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal O_Z$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal, def-pc-module-pullback]. Products $\mathcal K\mathcal F$ of a quasi-coherent ideal and a module, the powers $\mathcal K^n$ and the quotients $\mathcal F/\mathcal K\mathcal F$ are as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] (0). (1) $\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z$ is a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals of $\mathcal O_Z$, and for every affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with $i^{-1}(U)=\operatorname{Spec}(R/\mathcal J(U))$, one has $(\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z)(i^{-1}U)=\mathcal I(U)\cdot(R/\mathcal J(U))$, the image of $\mathcal I(U)$. (2) For every quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Z$-module $\mathcal G$ [pqf-def-coherent] and every $n\ge1$, $i_*\big((\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z)^n\mathcal G\big)=\mathcal I^n\,(i_*\mathcal G)$ as sub-$\mathcal O_X$-modules of $i_*\mathcal G$. (3) Consequently, for the quotient map $q:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G/(\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z)^n\mathcal G$, the map $i_*q$ induces an isomorphism $i_*\mathcal G/\mathcal I^n(i_*\mathcal G)\to i_*\big(\mathcal G/(\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z)^n\mathcal G\big)$, natural in $\mathcal G$ and compatible, for $m\ge n$, with the quotient maps from level $m$ to level $n$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma 088A (lemma-existence-tricky), lines 6961-6968: Coh(X_e, I_e) is identified 'without further mention' with the objects of Coh(X, I) annihilated by K^e, which needs this; the affine description follows Morphisms Lemma 01QO (morphisms-lemma-closed-immersion), Schemes Lemma 01I9 (schemes-lemma-widetilde-pullback: psi^* M~ = (S (x)_R M)~, psi_* N~ = (N_R)~) and Morphisms Lemma 01QY (morphisms-lemma-i-star-equivalence: i_* exact on quasi-coherent modules); Stacks gives no separate lemma (statement assembled by the agent)
